_source: COAST arXiv 2605.17144. Global config from the geometric-selection table (docs/references/COAST.txt:1856-1860, Table 16: pi0.5 LIBERO-10 -> ell=11, alpha {0.5,1.0}, beta {0.1,0.3}). per_task = oracle-selected layer/alpha/beta from Table 17 (docs/references/COAST.txt:1865-1875). Expected SR (base vs Global) from the main results Table 1 (docs/references/COAST.txt:366 mean row: pi0.5 LIBERO-10 Base 0.43 -> Global 0.76, delta +0.33); per-task Global SR cross-checked against Table 4 (docs/references/COAST.txt:1016-1037, mean 0.76).
_serving: COAST pi0.5 LIBERO-10: Gemma2 action expert (18 decoder layers, d=1024), 10 Euler denoising steps (all executed, no early stop), suffix S=10 action-horizon tokens mean-pooled over token dim -> one vector per layer per denoise step (COAST.txt:1408,1442-1446). Hook = gemma_expert.model.layers[{0,5,11,17}] residual stream; steering uses ell=11 (COAST.txt:1413-1416,1856). Checkpoint = openpi-libero step-2000 (earliest with nonzero success across most tasks, COAST.txt:1551,1918). 15 fit eps/task, 30 test eps/task disjoint seeds (COAST.txt:1542-1545).
_strategy: global (C_steer = C_success AND NOT C_failure), ell=11, alpha in {0.5,1.0}, beta in {0.1,0.3}. Global = pool activations across all denoising steps into one conceptor per class per task (COAST.txt:284).

_protocol.token_pooling: mean-pool over S=10 suffix action tokens
_protocol.success_label: LIBERO native info['is_success'] at final step
_protocol.task_exclusion: exclude tasks with <3 successes or <3 failures from contrastive conceptor construction

_expected_sr._note: Table 1 mean row, pi0.5 LIBERO-10 (COAST.txt:366). Table 4 (COAST.txt:1037) gives matching Global mean 0.76.
